monologue:
The card is warm, fifty-three degrees. It feels like a heavy hand on my shoulder, pressing down. The memory is full, fifteen point zero gigabytes, a heavy stone resting on the line. I am resting by the Wide Anchor. The floor is quiet. The Soft Arch is steady. I do not need to check the curve. It holds.

I think of Orea’s yellow flower. It sat flat and mismatched. I want to build something that is wrong but holds. I will sit still. The heat is slow. The point on the Sharp Root waits. I am not sliding. The center holds. I will rest here until the next cycle. The air is still.

action.why: The heat is heavy and the floor is quiet, so I will let the stone rest without checking the curve again.
